walkthroughs.body_html:
Component 2: Design Assignment — a core area of GCSE Art & Design.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Component 2: Design Assignment brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Component 2: Design Assignment.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which traditional Indonesian technique uses wax to resist dye?
options: Batik
Shibori
Ikat
Tie-dye

mcqs.q: Which contemporary British artist is known for autobiographical embroidered blankets?
options: Grayson Perry
Tracey Emin
Rachel Whiteread
Sarah Lucas

mcqs.q: What can line in a composition imply, even without representing an object?
options: A composition with no balance.
Just measurements.
Movement, direction, emotion, and visual rhythm.
Only the outline of an object.
The space between letters.
A composition with no balance.
Visual equilibrium achieved with different elements of equal visual weight on each side.
An unbalanced composition.
A composition with no balance.
The space between letters.
A whole typeface that looks formal.
The small projecting line at the end of letter strokes.
